_note: Taska/tadika options whose fees are published by the operator itself (government agencies). Private centres don't publish fees online - parents type their own quotes. Checked on the official pages on the 'checked' date.

options.name: Tabika Perpaduan
options.note_en: Free, with no fees, says the Ministry of National Unity. 1,781 Tabika Perpaduan around Malaysia in 2026. Priority for children aged 5-6 who live, or whose parents work, within 10 km. Uniform and insurance follow JPNIN's rules - ask your Tabika.
options.note_ms: Percuma tanpa sebarang bayaran, kata Kementerian Perpaduan Negara. 1,781 Tabika Perpaduan di seluruh Malaysia pada 2026. Keutamaan kepada kanak-kanak berumur 5-6 tahun yang tinggal, atau ibu bapa bekerja, dalam lingkungan 10 km. Uniform dan insurans ikut peraturan JPNIN - tanya Tabika anda.

options.name: Taska Perpaduan
options.note_en: Free, with no fees, says the Ministry of National Unity. Only 41 Taska Perpaduan around Malaysia in 2026, so places are limited - ask your nearest Jabatan Perpaduan office.
options.note_ms: Percuma tanpa sebarang bayaran, kata Kementerian Perpaduan Negara. Hanya 41 Taska Perpaduan di seluruh Malaysia pada 2026, jadi tempat terhad - tanya pejabat Jabatan Perpaduan terdekat.

options.name: Tabika KEMAS
options.note_en: RM10 registration (covers your child's insurance) plus a parents' contribution of RM10-25, set by each Tabika's committee. In the comparison we count RM25 a month to be safe - ask your Tabika how often it's paid. Up to 30 children; priority for 6-year-olds.
options.note_ms: Yuran pendaftaran RM10 (untuk insurans anak) serta sumbangan ibu bapa RM10-25 yang ditetapkan oleh jawatankuasa setiap Tabika. Dalam perbandingan kami kira RM25 sebulan supaya selamat - tanya Tabika berapa kerap ia dibayar. Maksimum 30 kanak-kanak; keutamaan kepada umur 6 tahun.

options.name: Prasekolah KPM
options.note_en: Preschool classes in government primary schools, with healthy meals. Priority for low-income (B40) families and rural areas. Apply online through KPM's e-Prasekolah system.
options.note_ms: Kelas prasekolah di sekolah rendah kerajaan, dengan makanan sihat. Keutamaan kepada keluarga berpendapatan rendah (B40) dan kawasan luar bandar. Mohon dalam talian melalui sistem e-Prasekolah KPM.
